source_title: NPCIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 80 Seats at Narora Atomic Power Station
source_excerpt:
Vacancies: 80 · Posts: 12 designation(s) · Type: Central PSU Apprenticeship · Mode: Online · Fee: Not mentioned · Apply: 29 October 2026 (10:00 hrs) to 18 November 2026 (16:00 hrs) · Stipend: ₹10,560–₹12,300 per month · Selection: Shortlisting on percentage of marks · Location: Narora, Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh
Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL), a Government of India enterprise under the Department of Atomic Energy, has invited applications for engagement of apprentices at Narora Atomic Power Station (NAPS), Narora, District Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh. The official notice (Advertisement No. NAPS/HRM/APPRENTICE/02/2026) covers Trade Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice and Graduate Apprentice under the Apprentices Act, 1961 and the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992.
NPCIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 covers 80 seats at Narora Atomic Power Station. Trade Apprentice accounts for 50 seats (ITI Electrician 25, ITI Fitter 16, ITI Electronics Mechanic 9), Diploma Apprentice for 16 seats and Graduate Apprentice for 14 seats. The training is for a maximum of 12 months.
Applications are submitted online at the NPCIL careers page after mandatory registration on the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme 2.0 (NAPS 2.0) portal for Trade Apprentice or the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme 2.0 (NATS 2.0) portal for Diploma and Graduate Apprentice. The online form is open from 29 October 2026 (10:00 hrs) to 18 November 2026 (16:00 hrs).
⚠️ Application Alerts: check these before you submit the form.
🎯 Local candidates living within 16 km radius of Narora Atomic Power Station get first preference, subject to reservation criteria.
🎯 Seats reserved for identified Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): Trade Apprentice 2, Diploma Apprentice 1, Graduate Apprentice 1. Disability must be 40% or more.
📋 Official Source Chain: where the facts in this article were confirmed.
Official notice: Advertisement No. NAPS/HRM/APPRENTICE/02/2026 — NPCIL Apprentice Notice PDF
Official application route: Register on NAPS 2.0 (Trade, Establishment ID E05200901473) or NATS 2.0 (Diploma/Graduate, Establishment ID NUPBUC093592), then apply at npcilcareers.co.in
Official updates page: NPCIL Careers

Who Should Apply? (Quick Eligibility Check)
Indian nationals above 18 years of age.
ITI pass certificate in the respective trade (full-time/regular) for Trade Apprentice; Diploma pass certificate in engineering or technology (full-time/regular) for Diploma Apprentice; Graduate degree in engineering/technology or general streams (BBA, BA, B.Sc., B.Com., etc.) (full-time/regular) for Graduate Apprentice.
Age as on 18 November 2026: Trade 18–24 years, Diploma 18–25 years, Graduate 18–26 years (with category and PwBD relaxations as printed).
For Diploma and Graduate, the qualifying examination must have been passed within 5 years from 18 November 2026.
Have not already undergone or are currently undergoing apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act, 1961 in any government, PSU or private industrial organisation; have not absconded from previous training.
Meet the physical standards (height ≥137 cm, weight ≥25.4 kg, chest expansion ≥3.8 cm) and are free from contagious or infectious disease, including tuberculosis.
Willing to register on the required NAPS/NATS portal and apply under the correct Establishment ID.
Quick Overview – NPCIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026
Organisation: Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL)
Sector: Central PSU (Department of Atomic Energy)
Recruitment / Exam Name: Engagement of Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961
Notification / Advertisement No.: NAPS/HRM/APPRENTICE/02/2026
Post(s): Trade Apprentice (ITI Electrician, ITI Fitter, ITI Electronics Mechanic), Diploma Apprentice (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Civil), Graduate Apprentice (Mechanical, Electrical, Human Resource, Finance & Accounts, Contract & Material Management)
Job Location: Narora Atomic Power Station, Narora, PO NAPS Township, District Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh – 203389
Job Type / Nature: Apprenticeship training – Maximum 12 Months
Selection Basis: Shortlisting on percentage of marks obtained in the respective trade/discipline; first preference to candidates living within a 16 km radius of NAPS (subject to reservation)
Stipend: Trade ₹10,560 (1-year ITI) / ₹11,040 (2-year ITI); Diploma ₹10,900; Graduate ₹12,300 per month
Training Duration: Maximum 12 Months
Apply Between: 29 October 2026 (10:00 hrs) to 18 November 2026 (16:00 hrs)
Notification PDF: NPCIL Apprentice Notice PDF
What Posts Are Available? – NPCIL Apprentice Vacancy 2026
Stipend is per month. Age limits are as on 18 November 2026. Age relaxations apply as printed for reserved categories and PwBD.
Your percentage of marks in the respective trade/discipline decides who is shortlisted. Shortlisting is based on the percentage of marks obtained in the respective trade/discipline. In case of a tie in percentage, the candidate born earlier is considered; if the date of birth is also tied, the candidate with a higher percentage in Matriculation (10th) is placed higher. First preference goes to eligible local candidates living within a 16 km radius of NAPS, subject to reservation criteria. If sufficient local candidates are not available as per reservation, candidates from other areas are considered.
Who Is Eligible for NPCIL Apprentice 2026? – Education, Age & Domicile
Nationality, Domicile & Basic Requirements
Nationality: Only Indian Nationals above 18 years of age are eligible to apply.
Domicile / local condition: First preference to eligible local candidates living within a 16 km radius of Narora Atomic Power Station, Narora, District Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh, subject to fulfilment of reservation criteria. If eligible local candidates are not found as per the stipulated reservation criteria and category-wise distribution, eligible candidates from outside the local area shall be considered.
Trade Apprentice: ITI Pass Certificate in the respective trade (ITI Electrician, ITI Fitter or ITI Electronics Mechanic). Full-time/Regular.
Diploma Apprentice: Diploma Pass Certificate in engineering or technology in the respective discipline (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics or Civil) granted by a State Council or Board of Technical Education established by a State Government / by a University / by an Institute recognised by the State or Central Government as equivalent to a diploma. Full-time/Regular.
Graduate Apprentice (engineering/technology disciplines): Graduate Degree in engineering or technology in the respective discipline granted by a statutory University / by an institution empowered to grant such degree by an Act of Parliament or passed the graduate examination of professional bodies recognised by the Central Government as equivalent degree. Full-time/Regular.
Graduate Apprentice (Human Resource, Finance & Accounts, Contract & Material Management): Graduate or equivalent in general streams such as BBA, BA, B.Sc., B.Com. etc., other than engineering or technology, granted by a statutory University or an institution empowered to grant such degree by an Act of Parliament or passed the graduate examination of professional bodies recognised by the Central Government as equivalent degree. Full-time/Regular.
Only those candidates who have passed Diploma / Graduate degree qualifying examination within 5 years from the date of closing the online application, i.e. 18 November 2026, are eligible to apply on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal.
Qualification must be held by: Not stated in the notice beyond the 5-year condition for Diploma and Graduate.
Applicants awarded CGPA / GPA / SGPA or letter grades must produce the authenticated conversion table from their respective Institute / College / University. If not provided and no formula is available, the notice prints conversion standards (for example, 55% equivalent to 5.9 CGPA on 10-point scale, 6.5 for 60%, 7.0 for 65%).
What Is the Age Limit? (as on 18 November 2026)
Age is calculated as on 18 November 2026. Minimum age is 18 years for all.
✅ A 23-year-old UR Trade Apprentice candidate born on 19 November 2002 — eligible (as on 18 November 2026).
❌ A 25-year-old UR Trade Apprentice candidate born on 17 November 2001 — not eligible (one full year over the limit).
Use our Age Eligibility Calculator to check instantly.
Reservation: Category-wise distribution is printed (SC, ST, OBC (NCL), EWS, UR). A valid caste certificate in the prescribed Central Government format is required for SC/ST/OBC (NCL). OBC candidates must submit the latest certificate mentioning Creamy Layer / Non-Creamy Layer status; only Non-Creamy Layer is eligible for reservation.
PwBD: Disability should be 40% or more. Reserved seats: Trade Apprentice 2, Diploma Apprentice 1, Graduate Apprentice 1. Identified disabilities are listed by trade/discipline in the notice (examples include Deaf, Hard of Hearing, One Leg, One Arm, Low Vision, Cerebral Palsy, and others as specified for each stream).
What Is the Stipend? – Monthly Stipend
Trade Apprentice: ₹10,560 per month (for those who have completed one year of ITI course); ₹11,040 per month (for those who have completed two years of ITI course).
Diploma Apprentice: ₹10,900 per month.
Graduate Apprentice: ₹12,300 per month.
No other benefits, hostel or transport facility are provided. The stipend is as per the Apprentices Act and Rules.
No application fee is mentioned in the notification.
The NPCIL Apprentice online form 2026 is filled at npcilcareers.co.in from 29 October 2026 (10:00 hrs) to 18 November 2026 (16:00 hrs).
Step 0: Register on NAPS 2.0 or NATS 2.0
Trade Apprentice: Register as a candidate on the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme 2.0 (NAPS 2.0) portal at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in . Apply for Narora Atomic Power Station, NPCIL through Establishment Enrollment Identity No. E05200901473.
Diploma Apprentice and Graduate Apprentice: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme 2.0 (NATS 2.0) portal at https://www.nats.education.gov.in/ . Apply for Narora Atomic Power Station, NPCIL through Establishment Enrollment Identity No. NUPBUC093592.
Ensure Aadhaar is seeded with the bank account.
Complete registration on the respective NAPS/NATS portal and note the Establishment ID.
Fill the online application form on npcilcareers.co.in with all required details.
Upload the mandatory documents (birth certificate or 10th marksheet/certificate, 10th marksheet, ITI/Diploma/Graduate certificate and all semester/year marksheets, conversion certificate if applicable, residential proof if within 16 km, caste certificate if applicable, Income and Assets Certificate if applicable, disability certificate if applicable). Photograph: JPG, not more than 50 KB, minimum 240 × 180 pixels, maximum 640 × 480 pixels, colour with light/white background. Signature: JPG, not more than 20 KB, minimum 80 × 200 pixels, maximum 160 × 560 pixels.
Submit the form and keep a copy of the registration/acknowledgement.
Applications will not be accepted if not applied under the respective Establishment IDs.
Applying without first registering on the correct NAPS 2.0 or NATS 2.0 portal under the exact Establishment ID.
Uploading a photograph or signature outside the printed size and format limits.
Submitting after 16:00 hrs on 18 November 2026.
Not uploading the residential proof when claiming the 16 km local preference.
Using an email ID or mobile number that cannot be accessed later (no change is allowed after registration).
What Can Get Your Application Rejected?
अंतिम तिथि: ऑनलाइन आवेदन 18 नवंबर 2026 (16:00 बजे) तक।
कौन आवेदन कर सकता है: भारतीय नागरिक, आयु 18 वर्ष से अधिक। ट्रेड अप्रेंटिस के लिए संबंधित ट्रेड में आईटीआई पास, डिप्लोमा अप्रेंटिस के लिए इंजीनियरिंग/तकनीकी में डिप्लोमा, ग्रेजुएट अप्रेंटिस के लिए इंजीनियरिंग/तकनीकी या सामान्य स्ट्रीम में स्नातक। आयु सीमा 18 नवंबर 2026 को ट्रेड 24 वर्ष, डिप्लोमा 25 वर्ष, ग्रेजुएट 26 वर्ष तक (आरक्षण और पीडब्ल्यूबीडी छूट लागू)।
कैसे आवेदन करें: पहले एनएपीएस 2.0 (ट्रेड) या एनएटीएस 2.0 (डिप्लोमा/ग्रेजुएट) पर रजिस्टर करें, फिर npcilcareers.co.in पर ऑनलाइन फॉर्म भरें।
स्टाइपेंड: ट्रेड ₹10,560 / ₹11,040, डिप्लोमा ₹10,900, ग्रेजुएट ₹12,300 प्रति माह। अधिकतम 12 महीने का प्रशिक्षण। चयन अंक प्रतिशत के आधार पर शॉर्टलिस्टिंग से।

The SahisarkariJobs.in Analyst's Take – Is This Apprenticeship for You?
With 80 seats and shortlisting purely on percentage of marks in the trade or discipline, a candidate scoring well above the average in ITI, diploma or degree has a realistic chance, especially if living within the 16 km radius (first preference). The 50 Trade seats are the largest group; the 14 Graduate seats carry the higher stipend of ₹12,300. Roughly 19 days remain until the 18 November 2026 closing, so registration on the correct NAPS or NATS portal and form submission should be completed well before the 16:00 hrs cut-off.

What Are the Apprenticeship Terms & Conditions?
Training duration is a maximum of 12 months.
The contract of apprenticeship terminates on expiry of the training period.
Any premature termination or extension is dealt with as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules, 1992.
Those who are absent are liable to refund the whole cost of their training (the amount received as stipend) as determined by the Central Apprenticeship Advisor.
There is no obligation for employment of the apprentices on completion of their training; the apprentice shall have no right to claim any employment in NPCIL.
Neither is it obligatory on NPCIL to offer employment nor on the apprentice to accept employment under NPCIL.
No hostel or transport facility is provided.
Engagement is subject to medical fitness and submission of a police verification certificate.
Management reserves the right to cancel or alter the number of seats or the entire process without assigning any reasons.
In case of any discrepancy in the Hindi version, the English version will prevail for all purposes.
Document verification with originals.
Medical fitness check by the Competent Authority.
Submission of police verification certificate issued by District Police Authorities.
Signing of the apprenticeship contract with NPCIL.
Commencement of training at Narora Atomic Power Station for a maximum of 12 months.
Training ends on expiry of the period; no automatic employment.

Candidates must have a valid and active personal e-mail ID and mobile number till the completion of the selection process; no change is allowed once registered.
Corrigendum/Addendum, if any, will be published only on the NPCIL website www.npcilcareers.co.in .
The candidature is provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates; false or incorrect information leads to cancellation.
Management’s decision on eligibility, acceptance of applications, mode of selection and cancellation is final and binding.
Filling up of seats is solely at the discretion of the management based on suitability of the candidate.
Any person engaged for apprentice training shall enter into a contract of apprenticeship with NPCIL as per the Act and Rules.
The cut-off date for reckoning age limit, qualification etc. is the closing date of online application, i.e. 18 November 2026.
For queries, candidates may refer to the Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) section on the official website. Contact details are not printed in the notice. Official website: NPCIL Careers .

Important Links – NPCIL Apprentice Notification 2026
What is the last date to apply for NPCIL Apprentice 2026?
The last date to submit the online application is 18 November 2026 (16:00 hrs). The form opens on 29 October 2026 (10:00 hrs).
What is the age limit for NPCIL Trade Apprentice?
For Trade Apprentice, the maximum age is 24 years as on 18 November 2026 (minimum 18). Diploma is 25 years, and Graduate is 26 years, with printed relaxations for reserved categories and PwBD.
Is there an exam for NPCIL Apprentice, or is it interview-based?
There is no written exam or interview. Shortlisting is done on the percentage of marks obtained in the respective trade or discipline, with preference to local candidates within 16 km of NAPS.
What is the stipend for Trade Apprentice posts in this recruitment?
Trade Apprentice stipend is ₹10,560 per month for those who completed a one-year ITI course and ₹11,040 per month for those who completed a two-year ITI course.
Can final-year students apply for this recruitment?
The notice requires the ITI pass certificate for the trade and the Diploma/Graduate degree for the other streams (passed within 5 years of 18 November 2026 for Diploma and Graduate). Final-year students who have not yet obtained the pass certificate are not eligible.
Is this Apprentice post a permanent government job?
No. It is a training engagement under the Apprentices Act, 1961 for a maximum of 12 months. There is no obligation for employment on completion of training, and the apprentice has no right to claim any employment in NPCIL.
Can candidates from outside Uttar Pradesh apply?
Yes. First preference is given to candidates living within 16 km of NAPS, subject to reservation. If sufficient local candidates are not available, eligible candidates from other areas are considered.
Where will selected candidates be posted?
Training is at Narora Atomic Power Station, Narora, PO NAPS Township, District Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh – 203389. No hostel or transport facility is provided.
Do I need to register on NAPS or NATS before applying on the NPCIL site?
Yes. Trade Apprentice must register on NAPS 2.0 and apply under Establishment ID E05200901473. Diploma and Graduate Apprentice must register on NATS 2.0 and apply under Establishment ID NUPBUC093592. Applications under the wrong ID will not be accepted.
